title: List captured requests endpoint (GET /api/hooks/{id}/requests)
user_story: As a user, I need to list the captured webhook requests for a specific hook so I can see what has been received.
description: Implement GET /api/hooks/{id}/requests to return a paginated list of captured requests. Supports ?limit=N (default 50, max 200) and ?offset=N (default 0) query parameters. Each request in the list includes summary fields: request_id, method, path, content_length, source_ip, received_at — but NOT the full body or headers (those are in the detail endpoint). The response includes 'requests' array, 'count' (items returned), and 'total' (total requests for this hook). Returns 404 if the hook doesn't exist. A new database method list_requests_paginated() supports offset-based pagination.

acceptance_criteria.then: response is 200 with JSON containing 'requests' array of 5 items, 'count': 5, 'total': 5
response contains 3 requests starting from the 3rd newest, 'count': 3, 'total': 10
each request summary contains request_id, method, path, content_length, source_ip, received_at but NOT body or headers
response is 404 with structured JSON error
limit is clamped to 200 (no error, just cap the value)
requests are ordered by received_at descending (newest first)
integration tests verify pagination, ordering, empty list, 404, and limit clamping
